ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows the distribution of annual precipitation along the 35° latitude line of a certain continent, horizontally from the west coast of the continent to the east coast of the continent. Location C is in an inland low-precipitation area near the eastern part of the continent, and the annual precipitation is clearly relatively low; the area near C is not a position where precipitation simply and continuously decreases from the coast toward the inland, and precipitation near the east coast clearly rises again. Reasoning: The question asks for “another reason for the low annual precipitation at location C,” and limits it to “what are the local topographic conditions like.” Location C presents the feature of a local inland low-precipitation area, indicating that the entry of water vapor is blocked by surrounding terrain and that the topographic conditions are relatively closed, so it can be summarized as enclosed terrain.

raw_record.question_text: According to <image1>, what is another reason, in terms of local topographic conditions, for the low annual precipitation at location C?

method.method_draft: 读取题目问的是“丙处年降水量少的另一个原因”且限定为“当地地形条件如何”。先观察图中丙处位于内陆低降水区，不是降水随海岸单纯递减的位置，而像被周围地形阻隔形成的干旱区域。用降水少与水汽受地形阻挡的对应关系，概括当地地形条件为“地形闭塞”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图示为某大陆沿35°纬线的年降水量分布，横向从大陆西岸到大陆东岸，丙处位于靠大陆东部的内陆低降水区，年降水量明显偏少；丙附近不是从海岸向内陆单纯连续递减的位置，东岸附近降水又明显升高。推理：题目问“丙处年降水量少的另一个原因”，并限定为“当地地形条件如何”。丙处呈现内陆局部低降水特征，说明水汽进入受周围地形阻挡，地形条件较封闭，因此可概括为地形闭塞。
